info-cards-grid.looks: An optional heading and intro (with an optional button beside it) above a grid of 1 to 4 cards per row. Each card has an optional icon (above the title or beside it), a title, a subtitle, body text that can be a bulleted or numbered list, and up to two buttons. Cards are dark navy with white text by default; any card colour works.
info-cards-grid.use: The workhorse for grouping topics, services or audiences, with or without icons. The safe default when there are no images.
info-cards-grid.avoid: Cards built around photos: use Picture Cards or Image Text Card Row.

fields.sectionSubheading: One or two sentences under the heading.
fields.introButtonText: Optional button beside the heading, with introButtonLink.
fields.sectionButtonText: Optional button under the grid, e.g. 'View All', with sectionButtonLink.
fields.footerText: Optional small text under the grid.
fields.columns: Cards per row: 1 to 4 (default 3). Match the card count: 2, 4 or 8 cards → 2 or 4; 3, 6 or 9 → 3.
fields.headerAlignment: left (default) or center for the heading and intro.
fields.cardContentAlignment: left (default) or center for everything inside the cards. Centre suits short cards with icons.
fields.styleVariant: default; volunteer puts the whole grid on a warm beige rounded panel with lighter, softer cards (each card can then be filled or dashed-outline via cardStyle); button-top gives a wider heading with the intro button at the top right.

fields.icon: Optional line icon at the top of the card. Give every card an icon or none.
fields.title: The card heading, a few words.
fields.subtitle: Optional short line under the title.
fields.bodyContent: A paragraph, or a <ul>/<ol> list. Links inside become text links.
fields.overlayImage: A decorative background texture. Leave it empty unless asked.
fields.cardBackgroundColor: The card colour; empty keeps the default dark navy. The text switches to a readable colour on its own.
fields.iconLayout: Empty puts the icon above the title; left puts it beside the title.
fields.cardStyle: Only with the block's volunteer style: filled or outline (dashed border).
